notes.title: Down The Hole - Update 3
notes.content:
[h1]Whats New:[/h1]

[h1]Chapter 4 Now Available![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36961949/00fcfaeb82e29ecae96bbd660fe9c1aef8feeb35.jpg[/img]

[h2]Master volume setting added for more control over the audio in the game![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36961949/ce5495c14e908ddbb22f54321c501417d74e98eb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Fixed:[/h1]
- Editor input fields now max at 32 characters.
- Editor workshop upload and update description now supports 32 lines of text.
- Editor progress UI overlays correctly.
- Fixed toggle music not saving correctly.
- Multiple players spawning when clicking the Start Game button more than once.
- Player spawning when loading the level editor, caused multiple player spawning.
- Player collider scaled down so projectiles hit correctly

[h1]Added:[/h1]
- Projectiles now get removed on level change.
- Chapter 4.
- New enemy type: Goo Turret.
- Master audio slider in the settings menu.
- Custom shader for better optimization.
- Audio optimization.
- New SFXs.
- Selecting a chapter and going back will now take you to the chapter select instead of the menu.
- Once loaded into a story level, going back will take you to chapter select.
- Loading user levels and going back will take you to the user levels list.
- User levels play a different soundtrack from the menu.

notes.title: Down The Hole - Now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Down The Hole Release:[/h1]

Down The Hole started as a simple game made for a Game Jam. Development continued and many new elements, polish and more many more levels were created.

Down The Hole will come with two chapters for the story levels as more levels has been planned in future updates. User levels and a Level editor is available and users can publish their creations on the workshop.

[previewyoutube=ibwy33okTeU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]FAQ[/h2] 
[b][i]Question:[/i][/b] Will Down The Hole be worked on after release?
[b][i]Answer:[/i] [/b] Yes, Down The Hole is planned to be updated and worked on even after release.

[b][i]Question:[/i][/b] Why are my saved levels not showing up in user levels?
[b][i]Answer:[/i] [/b] Currently user levels are workshop levels that have been subscribed.

[b][i]Question:[/i][/b] In the editor how can I link levels I make?
[b][i]Answer:[/i] [/b] The levels you make need to be published to the workshop in order to link them as the next level.

[h2]Known Issues for Down The Hole[/h2] 
[b][i]Issue:[/i][/b] The player can sometimes get stuck in the ground if falling too fast.
[b][i]Resolution:[/i] [/b]You can restart the level or die from an enemy. Planned to add a reset option.

[b][i]Issue:[/i][/b] I have duplicated players, what can I do?
[b][i]Resolution:[/i][/b] This problem is rare but can still happen, going back to the menu can fix this problem.

[b][i]Issue:[/i][/b] My user levels did not show up
[b][i]Resolution:[/i][/b] Make sure you are connected to Steam and subscribed to the level of choice from the workshop, then go back to the menu and try again.

[b][i]Issue:[/i][/b] I named my level the same as another I made, was it overwritten?
[b][i]Resolution:[/i][/b] Levels with the same name can be overwritten without warning, this will be added in future updates.

[b][i]Issue:[/i][/b] Toggle music setting does not save when I re-launch the game.
[b][i]Resolution:[/i][/b] The toggle music setting currently does not save in the settings but is planned to be added in future updates.
